rules.governing_law: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Act, 1975 & Local Municipal By-laws
rules.primary_authority: Municipal Corporation Tree Authority / Local Nagar Parishad
secondary_authorities: Resident Welfare Association (RWA) / Society Managing Committee
statutory_conditions: Plantation on private property does not require prior felling permission, but planting along property perimeter must respect neighbor boundary lines and underground utility conduits.
Any future pruning or felling will be governed under Section 8 of the Tree Act, 1975 requiring formal Tree Officer permission.
Minimum 2-meter setback recommended from compound walls and sewer lines for deep-rooted species.
prohibited_species: Eucalyptus tereticornis (High water table depletion near foundations)

documents.name: Proof of Land Ownership (7/12 Extract, Property Card or Index-II / Society Allotment)
documents.description: Demonstrates lawful ownership or tenancy rights to initiate plantation on the parcel.

documents.name: Society / Co-owner No Objection Certificate (NOC)
documents.description: Required if the parcel is within a cooperative housing society or shared joint-ownership premises.

documents.name: Site Layout Sketch & Utility Clearance Plan
documents.description: Indicating planting spots clear of water mains, septic tanks, and overhead electric service wires.

documents.name: Selected Species List & Source Nursery Bill
documents.description: Optional but required if applying for municipal sapling subsidy or green property tax rebate.

rules.display_name: Private Commercial / IT Park / Industrial Campus
rules.governing_law: Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act & MPCB Green Belt Guidelines
rules.primary_authority: Municipal Corporation Tree Authority / MIDC Environment Cell
statutory_conditions: Commercial establishments with built-up area > 20,000 sq.m must comply with 15% green cover landscaping under MoEFCC Environmental Clearance.
Fire tender access paths (minimum 6m wide clear width) must remain unobstructed by tree canopies under 4.5m clearance.
Perimeter avenue plantation must maintain standard 3m interval spacing.
rules.recommended_canopy: Broad canopy native shade trees + Air pollution tolerant species

documents.name: Commercial Land Ownership / Lease Agreement
documents.description: Valid title deed or leaseholder agreement from MIDC or Municipal Authority.

documents.name: Sanctioned Landscape Masterplan & Fire Buffer Clearance
documents.description: Shows tree planting zones outside active emergency circulation and loading zones.

documents.name: Environmental Clearance / MPCB Consent to Operate (if applicable)
documents.description: Required if fulfilling mandatory industrial/commercial green-cover quota conditions.

documents.name: 3-Year Maintenance & Drip Irrigation Plan
documents.description: Ensures post-planting survival using recycled STP treated water.

rules.display_name: Municipal Public Land (Parks, Footpaths, Open Spaces)
rules.governing_law: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Act, 1975 & Municipal Public Parks Bye-laws
rules.primary_authority: Municipal Corporation Garden Department / Superintendent of Gardens & Tree Officer
statutory_conditions: Prior written approval and MoU/Permission Letter from the Municipal Tree Officer is mandatory before planting any tree on municipal land.
Citizens/NGOs undertaking public plantation must execute a maintenance undertaking for at least 3 years.
Plantation along pedestrian pathways must ensure at least 1.8m unobstructed pedestrian walkway.
Tree grates or circular soil beds of minimum 1m x 1m must be kept unpaved around the trunk base.
rules.recommended_canopy: Deep-rooted native flowering and evergreen avenue trees

documents.name: Formal Plantation Proposal & Municipal Permission Application
documents.description: Addressed to the Superintendent of Gardens with proposed coordinates and tree counts.

documents.name: Organization / NGO Registration Certificate & PAN
documents.description: Required if applying under NGO, CSR, or institutional partnership quota.

documents.name: Detailed Geo-tagged Site Plan with Coordinates
documents.description: Shows exact planting pits and distance from road curb and streetlights.

documents.name: 3-Year Maintenance & Survival Guarantee Undertaking (₹100 Stamp Paper)
documents.description: Statutory undertaking committing watering, tree guards, and replacement of dead saplings.

documents.name: Ward Engineer NOC (Underground Utility Conduits)
documents.description: Verifies that roots will not damage drainage lines, power cables, or gas pipelines.

rules.governing_law: Indian Forest Act, 1927 & Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980 / 2023
rules.primary_authority: Maharashtra Forest Department (Deputy Conservator of Forests - DFO / Range Forest Officer - RFO)
statutory_conditions: Strict statutory restriction: Unauthorized entry, digging, or plantation inside Reserved/Protected Forest is an offense under Section 26/33 of Indian Forest Act 1927.

All plantation activities must be executed exclusively through or in direct joint partnership with the Territorial Forest Department under approved Working Plans or Joint Forest Management (JFM) schemes.
Strictly 100% indigenous local forest species from local forest department nurseries only. Zero exotic or hybrid species allowed.
rules.recommended_canopy: Indigenous endemic forest climax species (Teak, Mahua, Ain, Dhavda, Banyan, Peepal)

documents.name: Formal Application to Deputy Conservator of Forests (DFO)
documents.description: Submission of project scope and intent under JFM or Compensatory Afforestation framework.

documents.name: Forest Compartment Map & GPS Perimeter Demarcation
documents.description: Survey of India / Forest Department Compartment number reference.

documents.name: Joint Forest Management (JFM) Resolution / MoU with Local Gram Sabha
documents.description: Mandatory community consent if working in fringe forest buffer villages.

documents.name: Endemic Forest Species Authenticity Certificate
documents.description: Certified provenance of saplings from Forest Department registered research nurseries.

documents.name: Stage-I Forest Clearance (if commercial/infrastructure linked)
documents.description: Required if plantation is part of statutory Compensatory Afforestation (CAMPA).

rules.governing_law: Maharashtra Land Revenue Code, 1966 & National Agroforestry Policy
rules.primary_authority: Department of Agriculture, Govt. of Maharashtra / Local Talathi & Gram Panchayat
secondary_authorities: Social Forestry Division / Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)
statutory_conditions: Farmers have full statutory rights to plant trees on their private farmland without prior permission.
Planting along the boundary (Bund planting) must maintain 1.5m clearance from adjoining survey boundaries to prevent root/shade encroachment.
Felling of specific scheduled timber species (Teak, Sandalwood, Rosewood) after maturity requires transit permit under Maharashtra Felling of Trees (Regulation) Act, 1964.
Eligible for direct government subsidies under Sub-Mission on Agroforestry (SMAF) and Mahatma Gandhi NREGS.
rules.recommended_canopy: Agro-forestry multi-purpose timber and fruit trees (Bamboo, Shevga/Moringa, Teak, Neem, Subabul bunds, Jamun)

documents.name: 7/12 Extract (Saat-Baara) & 8-A Land Record
documents.description: Recent revenue record demonstrating ownership and crop survey details.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & Bank Account Linked to DBT
documents.description: Required for receiving Direct Benefit Transfer subsidies under Agroforestry schemes.

documents.name: Farmland Boundary Map (Gat Nakasha)
documents.description: Cadastral map showing bund lines and boundary clearances.

documents.name: Gram Panchayat No-Objection / Intimation (if community bund)
documents.description: Only required if planting on village common boundaries or water channels.

rules.governing_law: National Highways Act, 1956 & NHAI Green Highways (Plantation, Transplantation, Beautification & Maintenance) Policy, 2015
rules.primary_authority: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) - Project Director / Regional Officer
secondary_authorities: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
State Forest Dept (if notified protected forest strip)
statutory_conditions: No planting within 3.5 meters of the paved roadway edge (Clear Zone for vehicular errant run-off safety).
Median plantation height restricted to maximum 1.5m to eliminate headlight glare without obstructing intersection sight triangles.
Tough, drought-tolerant species with deep non-lateral tap roots required to prevent pavement uplift.
Formal concession agreement or NHAI Green Corridor registration required for CSR/NGO implementations.
prohibited_species: Ficus benghalensis (Massive aerial root road damage)
Fruit trees attracting animals to high-speed lanes
rules.recommended_canopy: Avenue trees: Neem, Tamarind, Karanj, Cassia fistula, Gulmohar, Bougainvillea on medians

documents.name: NHAI Project Director Formal Permission / Concession Agreement
documents.description: Official permit granting access to the highway right-of-way chainage.

documents.name: Chainage-wise Landscape & Safety Alignment Plan
documents.description: Detailed plan indicating kilometer markers, setback distances, and median heights.

documents.name: Traffic Management & Worker Safety Plan (IRC Guidelines)
documents.description: Commitment for safety cones, high-visibility jackets, and water tanker escort protocols.

documents.name: 5-Year Performance & 80% Survival Guarantee Bond
documents.description: Standard NHAI requirement for institutional highway plantation partners.

rules.governing_law: Maharashtra State Highways Act & PWD Roadside Arboriculture Manual
rules.primary_authority: Public Works Department (PWD) - Executive Engineer / Assistant Engineer
statutory_conditions: Plantation line must maintain minimum 2.5m distance from the blacktopped carriage edge.
Sightline distance at horizontal curves and road junctions must remain completely free of thick shrubbery.
Must coordinate with Social Forestry Department for roadside sapling allocation under PWD quota.
rules.recommended_canopy: Sturdy native shade avenue trees (Karanj, Mahua, Shisham, Bael, Bakul)

documents.name: PWD Executive Engineer Road Access & Arboriculture Permission
documents.description: Written approval referencing highway chainage and road division.

documents.name: Site Sketch indicating Road Margin & Utility Lines
documents.description: Verifies safe distance from optical fiber cables and drainage ditches.

documents.name: Letter of Support from Local Social Forestry Division
documents.description: Required if claiming subsidized tree guards and saplings.

rules.governing_law: Railways Act, 1989 & Indian Railways Engineering Code for Track Safety
rules.primary_authority: Indian Railways (Divisional Railway Manager - DRM / Senior Divisional Engineer - Sr. DEN)
statutory_conditions: Strict track safety mandate: Zero planting permitted within 15 meters from the center line of the outermost railway track.
Trees under or near 25 kV Overhead Electric (OHE) traction lines are strictly prohibited if mature height exceeds 4 meters.
Signal visibility corridors must have 100% unobstructed sightlines for loco pilots.
All plantation on railway land must be backed by a formal MoU with the Railway Division under the IR Green Afforestation Policy.
prohibited_species: Trees prone to branch snapping (Gulmohar, Peltophorum)
rules.recommended_canopy: Dwarf flowering shrubs, low hedges, and low-growing ground cover outside safety envelope

documents.name: Senior Divisional Engineer (Sr. DEN) Land Access Sanction
documents.description: Mandatory railway division approval signed by the competent railway authority.

documents.name: Railway Safety Clearance & OHE Distance Certification
documents.description: Signed by Permanent Way Inspector (PWI) and Electrical Traction Inspector.

documents.name: Joint Track Boundary Inspection Report
documents.description: Confirms tree pits are beyond the statutory 15m safety setback.

documents.name: Institutional MoU / CSR Partnership Agreement with Railways
documents.description: Required for non-governmental or corporate plantation drives.

rules.governing_law: Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) Notification, 2019 under Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
rules.primary_authority: Maharashtra Coastal Zone Management Authority (MCZMA) / District Coastal Management Committee
statutory_conditions: In CRZ-I (Ecologically Sensitive - Mangroves/Mudflats/Sand dunes), only conservation and restoration of native mangrove and saline flora is permissible.
Zero earth excavation, reclamation, dumping of construction debris, or hard concrete tree guards permitted in No Development Zones (NDZ).
Mangrove buffer zone of 50 meters from high tide line is strictly protected under Bombay High Court Mangrove Order.
rules.recommended_canopy: Mangrove & Coastal species (Rhizophora mucronata, Avicennia marina, Sonneratia alba, Casuarina equisetifolia, Thespesia populnea, Coconut)

documents.name: CRZ Mapping & Distance from High Tide Line (HTL) Certificate
documents.description: Authorized CZMP (Coastal Zone Management Plan) demarcation map.

documents.name: Maharashtra Coastal Zone Management Authority (MCZMA) NOC / Clearance
documents.description: Required if plantation area falls in CRZ-I or involves community eco-restoration.

documents.name: State Mangrove Cell Recommendation Letter
documents.description: Mandatory if plantation is within 50m mangrove buffer or tidal creek boundaries.

documents.name: Local District Coastal Management Committee Permission
documents.description: Chaired by the District Collector.

rules.governing_law: Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 & MoEFCC Eco-Sensitive Zone Notification
rules.primary_authority: Chief Wildlife Warden, Maharashtra / National Board for Wildlife (NBWL)
statutory_conditions: Eco-Sensitive Zone surrounding National Parks (e.g., Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Tadoba, Radhanagari) requires statutory wildlife screening.
Zero introduction of exotic, invasive, or non-native flora allowed. Only species matching the localized micro-habitat ecosystem are permitted.
Must not construct any permanent fencing or physical barriers that hinder natural wildlife movement corridors.
rules.recommended_canopy: Endemic Western Ghats / Deccan forest flora (Ain, Hirda, Behda, Kadamba, Wild Ficus, Bamboo)

documents.name: Sanctuary Conservator / Wildlife Warden Clearance Certificate
documents.description: Confirms plantation aligns with Sanctuary ESZ Management Plan.

documents.name: Native Biodiversity & Micro-habitat Suitability Assessment
documents.description: Prepared by a certified botanist/ecologist ensuring zero invasive flora.

documents.name: Eco-Sensitive Zone Monitoring Committee Approval
documents.description: Chaired by District Magistrate and DFO (Wildlife).

rules.governing_law: State University / Education Dept Norms & Municipal Tree Authority Guidelines
rules.primary_authority: Campus Management / Registrar / Head of Institution
secondary_authorities: Local Forest Range Office (for sapling distribution)
statutory_conditions: Excellent suitability: Institutional campuses offer enclosed security, student volunteer power, and dedicated water infrastructure.
Planting locations must preserve sports grounds, expansion masterplans, and solar rooftop sun exposure.
Miyawaki dense forest models are highly successful on campus parcels > 500 sq.m.
rules.recommended_canopy: Medicinal, shade, and educational botanic gardens (Neem, Peepal, Ashoka, Bael, Amla, Kadamba, Gulmohar)

documents.name: Institution Head / Principal / Registrar Permission Letter
documents.description: Confirms campus authorization and designated plot allocation.

documents.name: Campus Master Plan showing Proposed Green Zone
documents.description: Ensures no conflict with future academic block constructions.

documents.name: Student Eco-Club / NSS Volunteer Caretaker Charter
documents.description: Documents sustainable post-planting watering and weeding teams.

rules.display_name: Industrial Estate / MIDC Green Belt Zone
rules.governing_law: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981 & MIDC Land Regulations
rules.primary_authority: Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) Environment Cell
statutory_conditions: Industries are statutorily required to develop a 33% green belt within their industrial plot as part of Consent to Establish/Operate.
Trees must be planted in 2 to 3 staggered rows along the boundary perimeter to act as a dust and acoustic buffer.
Species must have high Air Pollution Tolerance Index (APTI) and superior particulate capture capability.
prohibited_species: Species sensitive to sulfur dioxide and particulate accumulation
rules.recommended_canopy: High APTI species: Neem, Peepal, Banyan, Karanj, Shisham, Terminalia arjuna, Alstonia scholaris

documents.name: MIDC Allotment Letter & Lease Agreement
documents.description: Proof of industrial plot boundaries and category.

documents.name: MPCB Consent to Establish / Operate (Copy)
documents.description: Specifies mandatory green belt percentage condition.

documents.name: Green Belt Layout Map with 3-Row Staggered Buffer Specification
documents.description: Delineates perimeter green buffer and total canopy coverage.

documents.name: Treated Effluent / STP Water Irrigation Layout
documents.description: Mandatory to show zero discharge recycling for green belt maintenance.

rules.display_name: Riverbank / Lake Perimeter / Canal Buffer (Riparian Zone)
rules.governing_law: Maharashtra Irrigation Act, 1976 & River Regulation Zone (RRZ) Norms
rules.primary_authority: Water Resources Department (Irrigation Dept) / Local River Basin Authority
statutory_conditions: Plantation within Blue Line (Prohibitive Flood Zone) and Red Line (Restrictive Flood Zone) requires Irrigation Dept clearance.
Soil-binding riparian species with fibrous root networks are mandated to prevent bank erosion and siltation.
Zero concrete or stone revetment damage permitted during pit excavation.
rules.recommended_canopy: Riparian bank stabilizers: Bamboo (Dendrocalamus), Arjun (Terminalia arjuna), Jamun, Indian Willow, Karanj

documents.name: Water Resources / Irrigation Department Permission NOC
documents.description: Clearance confirming tree roots will stabilize bank without blocking flood discharge.

documents.name: Irrigation Section Engineer Joint Inspection Memo
documents.description: Confirms distance from highest flood line (HFL) and canal embankments.

documents.name: Gram Panchayat / Municipal Catchment Protection Resolution
documents.description: Required for community lake rejuvenation and riverfront greening drives.
